A funny book for a grown-up

The Cake That Quit

“Of course,” Luke said, grabbing his jacket. “The cake has boundaries.”

Luke has switched off his phone, rented a cottage and spent four hours icing his cake. Now he’s chasing it through a village in front of six ducks and an audience with camera phones.

Start with a detail you share

For the friend with a milestone birthday
What would their perfect day look like, and what could possibly derail it? Try “A lifelong cyclist turns 50. Every road sign points back to the pub where we first met.”
For your partner
Choose an incident that still makes you both laugh. The wrong train you caught on your first date could become the beginning of a very different journey.
For a parent or grandparent
Try a quieter adventure around a real interest. A retired gardener hears a midnight knock at the greenhouse door. Who has been borrowing the trowel?

Before you give it to them

Will the character look like an adult?
Use a clear photo of the person who stars. The character’s age and the reading level are separate choices, so an adult can appear in a grown-up comedy or in a story for their grandchildren.
Can I check the joke lands?
Read the words and review the opening illustrated pages in the free preview. You can change the wording and add a private dedication before buying.
Which sizes can I order?
With £3.99 UK postage, the A5 hardback is £28.98 delivered (£24.99 for the book). The larger A4 hardback is £33.98 delivered (£29.99 for the book).
How much time should I allow?
Your full illustrated proof is ready within seven calendar days of payment. After you approve it, printing and UK delivery usually take another 7 to 12 working days. Allow extra time for changes. See ordering and delivery.

Who’s the hero of your in-joke?

Bring their photo and a couple of lines about the two of you. The book maker will start with an adult reading level.
